acceptance.given: A governed fixture contains headings for required declarations or sections but omits the substantive declarations or referenced content.

oracle.expected: Validation rejects the fixture and reports the violated rule with the relevant relative location.
forbidden: Validation accepts headings alone as satisfying required declarations or sections.
Validation reports success without identifying the missing substantive content.
oracle.observable: The validator result and diagnostic assertion from scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a01 show a rejection for the headings-only fixture with a rule identifier and relative path or location.

acceptance.then: The validator rejects the headings-only fixture and exposes a rule/location diagnostic.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a01 must fail if the validator accepts a fixture that supplies only headings for required declarations or sections.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted test_a01 passes against the real validator, and the whole skill-quality test module plus terminal validation retain the same rejection semantics.
